subject: Post-call recap: Acme Health private/VPC discovery & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Susan Patel <s.patel@acmehealth.com>, Acme Health Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Acme Health private/VPC discovery & next steps

Hi Susan / team,

Thanks again for carving out time today - appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps to keep momentum.

Key pain points we heard
- Data residency & regulatory: PHI must remain in-scope for on-prem/VPC-hosted inference, with strict logging and retention controls.
- Network constraints: Production environment will be behind an isolated VPC with no public egress for certain subnets; outbound connections must go through customer-approved NAT/proxy.
- Air-gap requirement: Some BAA-covered workloads will require an air-gap or very strict restricted egress for model updates.
- Audit & key management: Customer-managed KMS/HSM preferred; audit trail / immutable logs required for security review.
- Performance SLOs: Target 99th percentile tail latency < 250ms for search/clinical workflows; throughput estimate ~ 200 qps during peak.

Goals we agreed on
1) Validate technical feasibility for a Private/VPC deployment with isolated network paths and CMK integration.
2) Scope a pilot (subset of workloads) in ~8 weeks to satisfy security review.
3) Produce a mutual action plan (MAP) and procurement checklist to accelerate SOW.

Open items / assumptions
- Assume pilot will use customer VPC in us-east-2 (we can adjust).
- Clarify whether model updates must be air-gapped or if signed/verified artifacts via a secure pipeline are acceptable.
- Need customer network diagram and firewall rules for exact port/hostname allowlist.

Next steps (owner / ETA)
1) Marissa: Share SOC 2 type II + high-level architecture + MAP (attached) - today.
2) Camila: Schedule technical deep dive to walk networking & deployment options (proposed times below).
3) Acme: Share network diagram, list of egress proxies / NATs, and procurement timeline by 2027-06-10.

Proposed times for technical deep dive (Camila + Wayne / CloudOps):
- Tue 2027-05-25 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed 2027-05-26 14:00-15:00 PT

I've attached a stub SOC2 report and a simple network diagram example to illustrate the ports/endpoints we typically need to allow for telemetry and licensing checks (we can avoid any direct model download if required).

Happy to adjust based on your procurement timeline - looping Camila for the technical sync.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_soc2_type2.pdf (summary), redwood_network_diagram_stub.png, RDW-Acme-MAP-20270520.xlsx

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Acme Health private/VPC discovery & next steps

Thanks Marissa - that's helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Confirmed: PHI workloads must be isolated. For those workloads we will require either an air-gapped environment or an approved host-based egress control that blocks all outbound traffic except to a small set of endpoints.
- For pilot scope, security would like to see how you handle model updates without internet access (signed artifacts / internal pipeline is preferred).
- We'll need details on KMS integration (customer-managed keys) and where audit logs are retained.

I'm looping in Wayne from CloudOps to coordinate the networking details. Procurement (cc'd) will start a T&Cs/contract timeline - we're aiming to have vendor security review completed by 2027-06-10.

Wayne - can you confirm which engineers should join the technical deep dive? Also please advise on our typical passthrough egress proxies for telemetry (we can share a diagram).

On timeline, if security signs off internally we'd like a pilot kickoff in mid-June.

- Susan
Dr. Susan Patel
VP, Clinical Informatics | Acme Health
